name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 13 visits over 37 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-05-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
